included_conclusions.label: thm:pfaffian-intro

included_conclusions.hypotheses: Field k; NeZero (2:k); homogeneous cubic p; four alternating 6x6 coefficient matrices A; polynomial of pfaffianCubic A equals p; conclusion is original hypersurface rational section.
included_conclusions.difference: Matches v3, including the identically zero Pfaffian. Four alternating coefficient matrices encode the matrix of homogeneous linear forms; a rational section expresses a nontrivial projective zero.

included_conclusions.label: lem:lift
included_conclusions.title: Complete mixed-characteristic degree-preserving lifting
included_conclusions.hypotheses: Positive-characteristic field with actual prime characteristic; nonzero homogeneous smooth cubic and original closed point x. Constructs complete CharZero DVR R, surjective R→k, actual smooth lifted cubic equation, finite flat closed family of rank residueDegree(x) everywhere, and IsPullback square recovering same original closed subscheme P.
included_conclusions.difference: Matches arbitrary imperfect-field manuscript scope; no supplied DVR, Cohen ring, family, smooth Hilbert point, field-finite-generation, perfectness or desired geometry premise on final natural roots. Outer prime-uniformizer variant is even stronger.
included_conclusions.note: The v3 proof cites global smoothness of the relative Hilbert scheme via Fogarty. The selected Lean route constructs the global family and proves smoothness at the original closed-point classifier, sufficient for this lifting conclusion; it does not prove Fogarty global smoothness.

included_conclusions.difference: All-field theorem omits p != 0 (stronger). Positive-characteristic global-method endpoint retains p != 0 and prime-characteristic data from the method.
included_conclusions.note: Do not describe the global-method endpoint alone as all-characteristic, or claim that DEEP6507 rewrote older terminal constants to the global route. Pair with Theorem5.1/all-field endpoint for full scope.
